verdict.rationale: Braintrust's self-hosted deployment lets you deploy and control the infrastructure that stores your AI data in your own cloud account and region. That implies you can govern retention and deletion of that data yourself. The API also says it can 'create and manage' projects, experiments, and datasets, but no doc explicitly describes retention or deletion controls. Missing for 10: configurable retention policies/TTLs for logs and traces, documented deletion APIs or UI for traces/projects/datasets, retention controls on the managed cloud tier, independent corroboration.
